# `rst_table`

reStructuredText grid tables, for the Sphinx manual.

Usage: `from textkit.formats.rst_table import render`

Sample output:

```
+-----+---------------+-----+
| sku | name          | qty |
+=====+===============+=====+
| W-1 | Widget        | 3   |
+-----+---------------+-----+
| G-2 | Gadget, large |     |
+-----+---------------+-----+
```
